name: The set goes to snow
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) a warning at SARO. The screens break up for a while (a sign for the gear, FS47Omen).

beats.text: Snow on the set. Like something big is parked right next to the set.
At {clock} the TV and the screens went to snow for a few seconds, with a whine under it. No wind, nothing on the road.
